titulo: Drawing the way to her place
caption:
Drawing the way to her place

A small house, four dots and a star. The way to her place took less time to draw than to describe.

A drawing of the route beats three sentences of left, right and the one with the tree.

For whoever draws the way instead of describing it.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a blank sheet of paper with a small orange square house at its bottom left. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and four grey dots appear one after another up the page, a trail leading away from the house, and a gold star lights at the end of the trail. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me drawing the way, not describing it.
